product.name: LoopLite
product.one_liner: Minimal habit tracker with streak widgets
product.audience: Busy adults who abandon complex habit apps

assumptions: Creator can use Google Play billing and AdMob in their region
Primary market is English-speaking Android users

categories.summary: Clear pain: complex habit apps overwhelm
categories.why: Busy adults abandon multi-feature habit apps; LoopLite targets streaks-only.
categories.why_not_higher: No primary interviews or review quotes proving willingness to switch.

evidence.quote: Minimal habit tracker for people who quit complex apps

categories.summary: Streaks-only angle exists but weakly owned
categories.why: Competes with Loop Habit Tracker and Streaks on the same core loop; uniqueness is thin.
categories.why_not_higher: Needs a hard wedge (offline widgets, privacy, or niche workflow) vs named peers.

evidence.quote: Simple streaks. No RPG. No social.

categories.summary: Frequency cap added; consent still missing
categories.why: Interstitials now gated by lastShownAt + 3 minutes. UMP still absent.
categories.why_not_higher: Add UMP consent and a non-ads revenue path.

categories.why: Single screenshot shows default purple Material primary and uneven spacing.
categories.why_not_higher: Custom palette, type scale, and consistent 8dp spacing across screens.

evidence.quote: Default purple AppBar; dense list tiles

categories.why: Notification permission moved to reminder enable path.
categories.why_not_higher: First-run coach mark / empty-state still light.

categories.summary: Streaks exist; no return trigger beyond local notifs
categories.why: Habit model stores streakCount; no meaningful re-engagement beyond permission ask.
categories.why_not_higher: Widget + smart reminder cadence with measured D1/D7.

categories.summary: Listing improved; still no share loop
categories.why: Longer description and feature bullets added.

evidence.quote: Track up to 7 habits. Widgets. No RPG noise.

categories.why: Feature folders exist; one widget test; Crashlytics absent.
categories.why_not_higher: Add crash reporting and tests around streak edge cases.

categories.summary: Privacy URL in listing; ads consent still open
categories.why: Listing now includes privacy URL; UMP not implemented.
EmptyHabits view with Create CTA ships.
categories.why_not_higher: Offline and error states still thin.

evidence.quote: No habits yet · Create your first streak

findings.title: No UMP/consent flow before ads
findings.why: Ads still initialize without a consent form where required.
findings.counterpoint: Non-personalized ads only could reduce risk short-term.
findings.fix: Integrate UMP and gate personalized ads on consent.

findings.title: Still no hard wedge vs Loop Habit Tracker
findings.why: Core loop remains generic streaks; listing claims are not unique.
findings.counterpoint: Execution quality can win a niche without a novel feature.

evidence.quote: Track up to 7 habits. Widgets. No RPG noise.

findings.fix: Pick one ownable wedge (privacy-first, home-screen widgets pack, or coaching) and lead with it.

findings.title: No home-screen widget yet
findings.why: Streaks need a glanceable return surface; none found.
findings.counterpoint: Notifications alone can work if well timed.

evidence.quote: No habits yet · Create your first streak

strengths.title: Permission ask moved to reminder enable
Home empty state with clear CTA

evidence.quote: No habits yet · Create your first streak

verdict_line: Core UX wounds from v1 are closed; monetization consent and differentiation still decide whether this earns.
